## Immutable basis

## Boundary
Only listed IDs and adjacent blank lines may change. Paths begin `tests/unit/`. `D[owner]`=leading string; `C[scope>next]`=maximal full-line region; `<previous>` is a disambiguating preceding-code anchor. Prefix with `tests/unit/<file>#D:` or `#C:<scope>:before:` and, when shown, `:after:`. Each resolves once.

Oracle retains three blobs; parses with `type_comments=True`; strips only allowlisted leading docstrings from current/final copies; normalizes only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; requires equal residual ASTs. Targets stay nonempty and shorter; tokens protect inline/unlisted comments. Current/final directive text+attachment (7) and shebangs (zero) stay exact.

## Protection / contracts / consumers
Protect all unlisted/inline prose and runtime strings, fixtures, assertions, regexes, prompts, and subprocess arguments. `test_code_review_ws2.py` and `test_code_review_ws4.py` module docstrings are not selected; concise headings/helpers remain protected. Keep all 7 directive-bearing physical lines exact; no owned blob has a shebang.

Preserve code-review normalization/routing/discovery/finalization, FP telemetry, snapshot provenance, per-pass/verifier class resolution, project triggers, WS2/WS4 dispatch, collection isolation, ticket-branch staging, and compaction selection/atomicity/performance.

Pytest collects every module. Interface `test_llm_framework.py`, `test_llm_optionality.py`, `test_review_budget.py`, and workflow `test_gate_midrun_fail_closed.py` consume WS4's local fixture/operation behavior. `gate_dispatch.py` keeps a re-export used by the FP-ledger tests; per-pass/verifier and provenance/gate-session modules cross-reference each other. No selected value has a runtime docstring consumer.

## Independent review receipt
A non-author reviewer posts exactly 33 leaf-linked TSV PASS rows: `stable_block_id<TAB>before_citation<TAB>final_citation<TAB>preserved_contract_or_consumer<TAB>directives_exact<TAB>before_words<TAB>after_words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer_session`.

Before cites the frozen SHA; final cites its full SHA. Require `0 < after_words < before_words` and three PASS fields. Missing, duplicate, extra, author-reviewed, or non-PASS rows block closure.
